REMOVAL OF FRONT SHOCK ABSORBER

1. REMOVE DISC BRAKE CALIPER
Remove the disc brake caliper from the steering knuckle,
and suspend it with wire.

2. REMOVE TEMS ACTUATOR (w/ TEMS only)

FA02YL

3. LOOSEN PISTON ROD LOCK NUT
HINT: Loosen the piston rod lock nut until it can turn by
hand.
